name: io.github.fioenix/fn-ignis
title: fnIgnis Trend Intelligence & Market Research
description: Self-hosted autonomous trend intelligence & market opportunity discovery MCP server

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Without it the server uses sqlite:///ignis.db in the container's working directory, which is ephemeral and disappears with the container. Set a PostgreSQL DSN, or mount a volume and point a sqlite:/// path into it, for persistent operation.

environmentVariables.name: DEFAULT_GEO
environmentVariables.description: Default ISO-3166 region code (e.g. VN, US, JP, SG)
